sources.title: EleutherAI/pythia-160m · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The Pythia Scaling Suite is a collection of models developed to facilitate interpretability research (see paper). It contains two sets of eight models of sizes 70M, 160M, 410M, 1B, 1.4B, 2.8B, 6.9B, and 12B. sources.title: Jev AI Model (TypeSafe) — Typed System One Decisions
sources.snippet: Jev is TypeSafe AI's System One model: it returns a choice, score, or yes/no probability instead of chat. The hosted API is open as of 21 September 2026. $0.042 per 1M input tokens, output free.
